profiles.unknown: No known model, provider account, costs, timing, context, request-enumeration or complete scan claim.

profiles.grain: client/provider/model/basis/UTC-day aggregate over heterogeneous source records
profiles.unknown: Provider/model/cost/duration remain nullable; missing metric coverage must not become measured zero. Generic record count is not a request count.
profiles.coverage: source status plus per-row breakdownCoverage and tokenBasis

profiles.grain: keyed source-generation and observation revision with metric-specific numeric facts
profiles.unknown: Historical session exports have unknown token scope, lineage, cache-write TTL and streaming timing. Multiple unknown or overlapping executions cannot produce additive token totals. Native projection is revision zero unless the exporter runs with a private state directory, where a durable per-source-epoch ledger assigns corrective revisions and retractions inside one generation only.
profiles.coverage: Explicit per-kind unsupported/partial/complete source evidence measured by the producer (transcript request/tool/context fields counted present versus unmeasured) plus independent metric eligibility; local numeric facts only.

conversionRules: Only convert when subset and disjoint-partition evidence is known. Never add reasoning twice.
Do not invent cache-write TTL where only aggregate write volume exists.
Retain distinct cost evidence cohorts and per-metric eligible denominators.
Daily UTC aggregates cannot establish arbitrary timezone rebuckets, exact request quantiles or lineage.
Canonical integer counts use exact arithmetic and decimal-string transport; conversion beyond representability refuses.
